summary: Babcock & Wilcox Enterprises filed an 8-K reporting the entry into an underwriting agreement for a public offering of common stock. The company issued 12,432,432 shares, including full exercise of the underwriters' option, via a shelf registration statement. Terms include customary representations and indemnification. This is a routine equity offering, not a special situation—no acquisition, divestiture, or strategic change. The filing is an ordinary shelf takedown, so it does not qualify as a special situation category.
